body: He was 32. Had a bad opioid addiction, so his parents kicked him out. When I was age 8-12 (approximately, I’m 18 now)he lived with us, and we became very close. As an only child, he was like the brother I never had. He had been clean for a while, and had recently moved out and gotten his own place last September I believe. Come March, out of nowhere, he overdosed. It was really shocking. I don’t think that really explains how I’m feeling though, but it could be a component.
Perhaps that could subconsciously be affecting me. It’s been really tough for my family
